title: Fort Témiscamingue Eastern Storehouse
axis: Positive X points inland to the east-northeast. Positive Z follows the building axis toward the southeast.
source: Parks Canada archaeological site inventory and mapped trading-post context
identityStatus: Placed inland and slightly north of the western trade store to reconstruct the excavated commercial pair. The 16 m east and 6 m north offsets, building outline and bearing are estimates.

terrainContact.basis: Original present-day terrain beside the estimated western threshold.
